name: Grjadjot geroj
source:
Legends speak of a hero who would come when Enelle faces its darkest hour. Now, that time has come – and his story is about to unfold.

[From [url=https://elilit.itch.io/hero-is-coming]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
传说中，当艾妮尔面临最黑暗的时刻时，一位英雄就会出现。现在，那个时刻已经到来——他的故事即将展开。

[来自[url=https://elilit.itch.io/hero-is-coming]Itch.io[/url]]
